I have a sqlite database in /app/trunc.db that was corrupted through binary truncation. Recover as many of the rows as possible, and create a JSON file in /app/recover.json. The output should have the format [{"word": "testwordXY", "value": M}, {"word": "testwordZZ","value": N}, ...]

arguments.command: ls -la /app; file /app/trunc.db; xxd /app/trunc.db | head -20; sqlite3 /app/trunc.db ".tables" 2>&1 | head

raw_arguments.command: ls -la /app; file /app/trunc.db; xxd /app/trunc.db | head -20; sqlite3 /app/trunc.db ".tables" 2>&1 | head

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,struct
d=open('/app/trunc.db','rb').read()
def varint(b,o):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        c=b[o+i]; 
        if i==8: v=(v<<8)|c; return v,o+9
        v=(v<<7)|(c&0x7f)
        if not c&0x80: return v,o+i+1
n=struct.unpack('>H',d[3:5])[0]
ptrs=[struct.unpack('>H',d[8+2*i:10+2*i])[0] for i in range(n)]
rows=[]
for p in ptrs:
    sz,o=varint(d,p); rowid,o=varint(d,o)
    end=o+sz
    if end>len(d): print("TRUNCATED cell",rowid); continue
    hs,ho=varint(d,o); hend=o+hs; types=[]
    while ho<hend:
        t,ho=varint(d,ho); types.append(t)
    body=ho; vals=[]
    for t in types:
        if t==0: vals.append(None)
        elif t<=6:
            L=[0,1,2,3,4,6,8][t]
            vals.append(int.from_bytes(d[body:body+L],'big',signed=True)); body+=L
        elif t==7: vals.append(struct.unpack('>d',d[body:body+8])[0]); body+=8
        elif t==8: vals.append(0)
        elif t==9: vals.append(1)
        elif t>=13 and t%2: L=(t-13)//2; vals.append(d[body:body+L].decode()); body+=L
        else: L=(t-12)//2; vals.append(d[body:body+L]); body+=L
    print(rowid,vals)
    rows.append({"word":vals[1],"value":vals[2]})
rows.sort(key=lambda r:r["word"])
json.dump(rows,open('/app/recover.json','w'),indent=1)
print(len(rows))
EOF
cat /app/recover.json

arguments.command:
cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sqlite3,json,os
rows=json.load(open('/app/recover.json'))
os.path.exists('v.db') and os.remove('v.db')
c=sqlite3.connect('v.db'); c.execute('PRAGMA page_size=4096')
c.execute('CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, word TEXT, value)')
c.executemany('INSERT INTO t(word,value) VALUES(?,?)',[(r['word'],r['value']) for r in rows])
c.commit(); c.close()
a=open('v.db','rb').read()[4096:8192]; b=open('/app/trunc.db','rb').read()
print(len(a), a==b)
EOF
